title: Read-only investigation of cancellation and stock restoration

criteria.description: The explanation matches the code: cancel_order checks the order is placed, releases each line's recorded allocations back to the warehouses they came from, marks the order cancelled, and the stock ledger writes audit entries; nothing is invented.
It explains that stock returns to the specific warehouses recorded per order line at placement, not by current priority, and shows an example.
It states correctly that the codebase has no reservation concept: stock is taken when the order is placed.
It cites files and functions so the reader can verify the claims.
It mentions the cases that block or change the flow (shipped or already cancelled orders are rejected, unknown warehouse aborts before any change).
